title: Idylls of the King
author: Tennyson, Alfred Tennyson, Baron
description: "Idylls of the King" by Baron Alfred Tennyson Tennyson is a cycle of twelve narrative poems published between 1859 and 1885.
longDescription: This retelling of the Arthurian legend follows King Arthur's attempt to create a perfect kingdom, from his rise to power through his tragic downfall.

authorInfo.bio: Tennyson, Alfred Tennyson, Baron (1809–1892) wrote Idylls of the King. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
authorInfo.edition: Complete historical source edition, with original credits and licence retained.

rights: Source edition: public domain in the United States. Listed creative contributors screened for India, UK and EU; original licence retained.
